process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects usage of the Chisel tunneling tool via the commandline arguments
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - CleanWipe Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of CleanWipe a tool usually used to delete Symantec antivirus.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Crassus Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects Crassus, a Windows privilege escalation discovery tool, based on PE metadata characteristics.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - CsExec Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of the lesser known remote execution tool named CsExec a PsExec alternative
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - DefenderCheck Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of DefenderCheck, a tool to evaluate the signatures used in Microsoft Defender. It can be used to figure out the strings / byte chains used in Microsoft Defender to detect a tool and thus used for AV evasion.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - DIT Snapshot Viewer
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of Ditsnap tool, an inspection tool for Active Directory database, ntds.dit.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Furkan Caliskan (@caliskanfurkan_)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Fast Reverse Proxy (FRP) Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of Fast Reverse Proxy. frp is a fast reverse proxy to help you expose a local server behind a NAT or firewall to the Internet.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113, Florian Roth

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA- IOX Tunneling Tool Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of IOX - a tool for port forwarding and intranet proxy purposes
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Kernel Driver Utility (KDU) Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects execution of the Kernel Driver Utility (KDU) tool.
KDU can be used to bypass driver signature enforcement and load unsigned or malicious drivers into the Windows kernel.
Potentially allowing for privilege escalation, persistence, or evasion of security controls.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Matt Anderson, Dray Agha, Anna Pham (Huntress)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Memory Dump Mount Via MemProcFS
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects execution of MemProcFS a memory forensics tool with the '-device' parameter.
MemProcFS mounts physical memory as a virtual file system, allowing direct access to process memory and system structures.
Threat actors were seen abusing this utility to mount memory dumps and then extract sensitiv
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Mouse Lock Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: In Kaspersky's 2020 Incident Response Analyst Report they listed legitimate tool "Mouse Lock" as being used for both credential access and collection in security incidents.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Cian Heasley

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Netcat Suspicious Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects execution of Netcat. Adversaries may use a non-application layer protocol for communication between host and C2 server or among infected hosts within a network
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - SoftPerfect Netscan Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects usage of SoftPerfect's "netscan.exe". An application for scanning networks.
It is actively used in-the-wild by threat actors to inspect and understand the network architecture of a victim.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: @d4ns4n_ (Wuerth-Phoenix)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Ngrok Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects the use of Ngrok, a utility used for port forwarding and tunneling, often used by threat actors to make local protected services publicly available.
Involved domains are bin.equinox.io for download and *.ngrok.io for connections.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Nimgrab Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the usage of nimgrab, a tool bundled with the Nim programming framework and used for downloading files.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - NimScan Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects usage of NimScan, a portscanner utility.
In early 2025, adversaries were observed using this utility to scan for open ports on remote hosts in a compromised environment.
This rule identifies the execution of NimScan based on the process image name and specific hash values associated with dif
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - NirCmd Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of NirCmd tool for command execution, which could be the result of legitimate administrative activity
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - NirCmd Execution As LOCAL SYSTEM
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of NirCmd tool for command execution as SYSTEM user
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Nmap/Zenmap Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects usage of namp/zenmap. Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts, including those that may be vulnerable to remote software exploitation
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - NPS Tunneling Tool Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of NPS, a port forwarding and intranet penetration proxy server
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - NSudo Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of NSudo tool for command execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - PingCastle Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of PingCastle, a tool designed to quickly assess the Active Directory security level.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - PingCastle Execution From Potentially Suspicious Parent
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of PingCastle, a tool designed to quickly assess the Active Directory security level via a script located in a potentially suspicious or uncommon location.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), X__Junior (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Process Hacker Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects the execution of Process Hacker based on binary metadata information (Image, Hash, Imphash, etc).
Process Hacker is a tool to view and manipulate processes, kernel options and other low level options.
Threat actors abused older vulnerable versions to manipulate system processes.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Radmin Viewer Utility Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of Radmin which can be abused by an adversary to remotely control Windows machines
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Potential PE Metadata Tamper Using Rcedit
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of rcedit to potentially alter executable PE metadata properties, which could conceal efforts to rename system utilities for defense evasion.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Micah Babinski

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Rclone Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects execution of RClone utility for exfiltration as used by various ransomwares strains like REvil, Conti, FiveHands, etc
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Bhabesh Raj, Sittikorn S, Aaron Greetham (@beardofbinary) - NCC Group

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Restic Backup Tool Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects the execution of the Restic backup tool, which can be used for data exfiltration.
Threat actors may leverage Restic to back up and exfiltrate sensitive data to remote storage locations, including cloud services.
If not legitimately used in the enterprise environment, its presence may indicat
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nounou Mbeiri, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - RunXCmd Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of the RunXCmd tool to execute commands with System or TrustedInstaller accounts
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Seatbelt Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of the PUA/Recon tool Seatbelt via PE information of command line parameters
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - System Informer Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of System Informer, a task manager tool to view and manipulate processes, kernel options and other low level operations
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - TruffleHog Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects execution of TruffleHog, a tool used to search for secrets in different platforms like Git, Jira, Slack, SharePoint, etc. that could be used maliciously.
While it is a legitimate tool, intended for use in CI pipelines and security assessments,
It was observed in the Shai-Hulud malware campai
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - WebBrowserPassView Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of WebBrowserPassView.exe. A password recovery tool that reveals the passwords stored by the following Web browsers, Internet Explorer (Version 4.0 - 11.0), Mozilla Firefox (All Versions), Google Chrome, Safari, and Opera
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Wsudo Suspicious Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects usage of wsudo (Windows Sudo Utility). Which is a tool that let the user execute programs with different permissions (System, Trusted Installer, Administrator...etc)
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Adidnsdump Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
This tool enables enumeration and exporting of all DNS records in the zone for recon purposes of internal networks Python 3 and python.exe must be installed,
Usee to Query/modify DNS records for Active Directory integrated DNS via LDAP
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Python One-Liners with Base64 Decoding
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects Python one-liners that use base64 decoding functions in command line executions.
Malicious scripts or attackers often use python one-liners to decode and execute base64-encoded payloads, which is a common technique for obfuscation and evasion.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Hugh Ryan (HueCodes), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Python Inline Command Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects execution of python using the "-c" flag. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live python code.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Python Spawning Pretty TTY on Windows
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects python spawning a pretty tty
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nextron Systems

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potentially Suspicious Usage Of Qemu
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Qemu utility in a Windows environment.
Threat actors have leveraged this utility and this technique for achieving network access as reported by Kaspersky.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Muhammad Faisal (@faisalusuf), Hunter Juhan (@threatHNTR)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Query Usage To Exfil Data
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects usage of "query.exe" a system binary to exfil information such as "sessions" and "processes" for later use
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: QuickAssist Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of Microsoft Quick Assist tool "QuickAssist.exe". This utility can be used by attackers to gain remote access.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Muhammad Faisal (@faisalusuf)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Rar Usage with Password and Compression Level
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of rar.exe, on the command line, to create an archive with password protection or with a specific compression level. This is pretty indicative of malicious actions.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: @ROxPinTeddy

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Files Added To An Archive Using Rar.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects usage of "rar" to add files to an archive for potential compression. An adversary may compress data (e.g. sensitive documents) that is collected prior to exfiltration in order to make it portable and minimize the amount of data sent over the network.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Timur Zinniatullin, E.M. Anhaus, oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Greedy Compression Using Rar.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects RAR usage that creates an archive from a suspicious folder, either a system folder or one of the folders often used by attackers for staging purposes
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious RASdial Activity
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious process related to rasdial.exe
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: juju4

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: RDP Enable or Disable via Win32_TerminalServiceSetting WMI Class
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects enabling or disabling of Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) using alternate methods such as WMIC or PowerShell.
In PowerShell one-liner commands, the "SetAllowTSConnections" method of the "Win32_TerminalServiceSetting" class may be used to enable or disable RDP.
In WMIC, the "rdtoggle" alias or "
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Daniel Koifman (KoifSec), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Process Memory Dump via RdrLeakDiag.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of the Microsoft Windows Resource Leak Diagnostic tool "rdrleakdiag.exe" to dump process memory
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Cedric MAURUGEON, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Windows Recovery Environment Disabled Via Reagentc
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects attempts to disable windows recovery environment using Reagentc.
ReAgentc.exe is a command-line tool in Windows used to manage the Windows Recovery Environment (WinRE).
It allows users to enable, disable, and configure WinRE, which is used for troubleshooting and repairing common boot issues
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Daniel Koifman (KoifSec), Michael Vilshin

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: RegAsm.EXE Execution Without CommandLine Flags or Files
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects the execution of "RegAsm.exe" without a commandline flag or file, which might indicate potential process injection activity.
Usually "RegAsm.exe" should point to a dedicated DLL file or call the help with the "/?" flag.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of Regasm/Regsvcs With Uncommon Extension
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Regasm/Regsvcs utilities with an uncommon extension.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of Regasm/Regsvcs From Uncommon Location
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Regasm/Regsvcs utilities from a potentially suspicious location
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Exports Critical Registry Keys To a File
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the export of a crital Registry key to a file.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Oddvar Moe, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Exports Registry Key To a File
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the export of the target Registry key to a file.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Oddvar Moe, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Imports Registry Key From a File
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the import of the specified file to the registry with regedit.exe.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Oddvar Moe, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Imports Registry Key From an ADS
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the import of a alternate datastream to the registry with regedit.exe.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Oddvar Moe, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Regedit as Trusted Installer
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a regedit started with TrustedInstaller privileges or by ProcessHacker.exe
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Registry Modification From ADS Via Regini.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the import of an alternate data stream with regini.exe, regini.exe can be used to modify registry keys.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Eli Salem, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Registry Modification Via Regini.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of regini.exe which can be used to modify registry keys, the changes are imported from one or more text files.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Eli Salem, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: DLL Execution Via Register-cimprovider.exe
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects using register-cimprovider.exe to execute arbitrary dll file.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Ivan Dyachkov, Yulia Fomina, oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Enumeration for 3rd Party Creds From CLI
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects processes that query known 3rd party registry keys that holds credentials via commandline
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Registry Export of Third-Party Credentials
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects the use of reg.exe to export registry paths associated with third-party credentials.
Credential stealers have been known to use this technique to extract sensitive information from the registry.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: IE ZoneMap Setting Downgraded To MyComputer Zone For HTTP Protocols Via CLI
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to Internet Explorer's (IE / Windows Internet properties) ZoneMap configuration of the "HTTP" and "HTTPS" protocols to point to the "My Computer" zone. This allows downloaded files from the Internet to be granted the same level of trust as files stored locally.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Debugger Registration Cmdline
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the registration of a debugger for a program that is available in the logon screen (sticky key backdoor).
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community, Jonhnathan Ribeiro

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Logon Scripts - CommandLine
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the addition of a new LogonScript to the registry value "UserInitMprLogonScript" for potential persistence
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Tom Ueltschi (@c_APT_ure)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Credential Dumping Attempt Using New NetworkProvider - CLI
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects when an attacker tries to add a new network provider in order to dump clear text credentials, similar to how the NPPSpy tool does it
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Python Function Execution Security Warning Disabled In Excel
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects changes to the registry value "PythonFunctionWarnings" that would prevent any warnings or alerts from showing when Python functions are about to be executed.
Threat actors could run malicious code through the new Microsoft Excel feature that allows Python to run within the spreadsheet.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: @Kostastsale

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Privilege Escalation via Service Permissions Weakness
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detect modification of services configuration (ImagePath, FailureCommand and ServiceDLL) in registry by processes with Medium integrity level
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Provisioning Registry Key Abuse For Binary Proxy Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential abuse of the provisioning registry key for indirect command execution through "Provlaunch.exe".
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential PowerShell Execution Policy Tampering - ProcCreation
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the PowerShell execution policy registry key in order to bypass signing requirements for script execution from the CommandLine
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Hiding User Account Via SpecialAccounts Registry Key - CommandLine
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the registry key "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\SpecialAccounts\Userlist" where the value is set to "0" in order to hide user account from being listed on the logon screen.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: @Kostastsale, TheDFIRReport

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Persistence Via TypedPaths - CommandLine
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects modification addition to the 'TypedPaths' key in the user or admin registry via the commandline. Which might indicate persistence attempt
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Regsvr32 Commandline Flag Anomaly
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a potential command line flag anomaly related to "regsvr32" in which the "/i" flag is used without the "/n" which should be uncommon.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potentially Suspicious Regsvr32 HTTP IP Pattern
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects regsvr32 execution to download and install DLLs located remotely where the address is an IP address.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potentially Suspicious Regsvr32 HTTP/FTP Pattern
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects regsvr32 execution to download/install/register new DLLs that are hosted on Web or FTP servers.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Regsvr32 Execution From Remote Share
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects REGSVR32.exe to execute DLL hosted on remote shares
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potentially Suspicious Child Process Of Regsvr32
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of "regsvr32.exe".
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: elhoim, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Regsvr32 Execution From Potential Suspicious Location
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects execution of regsvr32 where the DLL is located in a potentially suspicious location.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Regsvr32 Execution From Highly Suspicious Location
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects execution of regsvr32 where the DLL is located in a highly suspicious locations
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Regsvr32 DLL Execution With Suspicious File Extension
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of REGSVR32.exe with DLL files masquerading as other files
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Scripting/CommandLine Process Spawned Regsvr32
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects various command line and scripting engines/processes such as "PowerShell", "Wscript", "Cmd", etc. spawning a "regsvr32" instance.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Regsvr32 DLL Execution With Uncommon Extension
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a "regsvr32" execution where the DLL doesn't contain a common file extension.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Attempt Via Run Keys Using Reg.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious command line reg.exe tool adding key to RUN key in Registry
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Add SafeBoot Keys Via Reg Utility
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" commands with the "add" or "copy" flags on safe boot registry keys. Often used by attacker to allow the ransomware to work in safe mode as some security products do not
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Reg Add BitLocker
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious addition to BitLocker related registry keys via the reg.exe utility
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Dropping Of Password Filter DLL
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects dropping of dll files in system32 that may be used to retrieve user credentials from LSASS
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Sreeman

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Windows Defender Folder Exclusion Added Via Reg.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" to add Defender folder exclusions. Qbot has been seen using this technique to add exclusions for folders within AppData and ProgramData.

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Use NTFS Short Name in Image

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Obfuscated IP Download Activity

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Obfuscated IP Via CLI
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects usage of an encoded/obfuscated version of an IP address (hex, octal, etc.) via command line
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), X__Junior (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Process Parents
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious parent processes that should not have any children or should only have a single possible child program
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential PowerShell Execution Via DLL
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects potential PowerShell execution from a DLL instead of the usual PowerShell process as seen used in PowerShdll.
This detection assumes that PowerShell commands are passed via the CommandLine.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Markus Neis, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Private Keys Reconnaissance Via CommandLine Tools
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Adversaries may search for private key certificate files on compromised systems for insecurely stored credential
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious RunAs-Like Flag Combination
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious command line flags that let the user set a target user and command as e.g. seen in PsExec-like tools
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Privilege Escalation via Named Pipe Impersonation
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a remote file copy attempt to a hidden network share. This may indicate lateral movement or data staging activity.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Windows Processes Suspicious Parent Directory
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detect suspicious parent processes of well-known Windows processes
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: vburov

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Program Names
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious patterns in program names or folders that are often found in malicious samples or hacktools
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Recon Information for Export with Command Prompt
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Once established within a system or network, an adversary may use automated techniques for collecting internal data.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Process Execution From Fake Recycle.Bin Folder
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects process execution from a fake recycle bin folder, often used to avoid security solution.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Redirection to Local Admin Share
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a suspicious output redirection to the local admins share, this technique is often found in malicious scripts or hacktool stagers
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Registry Modification of MS-settings Protocol Handler
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects registry modifications to the 'ms-settings' protocol handler, which is frequently targeted for UAC bypass or persistence.
Attackers can modify this registry to execute malicious code with elevated privileges by hijacking the command execution path.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Remote Desktop Tunneling
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential use of an SSH utility to establish RDP over a reverse SSH Tunnel. This can be used by attackers to enable routing of network packets that would otherwise not reach their intended destination.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Defense Evasion Via Right-to-Left Override
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects the presence of the "u202+E" character, which causes a terminal, browser, or operating system to render text in a right-to-left sequence.
This character is used as an obfuscation and masquerading techniques by adversaries to trick users into opening malicious files.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Micah Babinski, @micahbabinski, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems), Luc Génaux

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Script Interpreter Execution From Suspicious Folder
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects suspicious script execution from suspicious directories or folders accessible by environment variables that may indicate malware activity.
Script interpreters (cscript, wscript, mshta, powershell) executing from folders like Temp, Public, or user profile directories may suggest attempts to e
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Script Interpreter Spawning Credential Scanner - Windows
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects a script interpreter process (like node.js or bun) spawning a known credential scanning tool (e.g., trufflehog, gitleaks).
This behavior is indicative of an attempt to find and steal secrets, as seen in the "Shai-Hulud: The Second Coming" campaign.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Sensitive File Access Via Volume Shadow Copy Backup
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a command that accesses the VolumeShadowCopy in order to extract sensitive files such as the Security or SAM registry hives or the AD database (ntds.dit)
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems), Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious New Service Creation
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects creation of a new service via "sc" command or the powershell "new-service" cmdlet with suspicious binary paths
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Service Binary Directory
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a service binary running in a suspicious directory
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Windows Service Tampering
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the usage of binaries such as 'net', 'sc' or 'powershell' in order to stop, pause, disable or delete critical or important Windows services such as AV, Backup, etc. As seen being used in some ransomware scripts
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113 , X__Junior (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Shadow Copies Creation Using Operating Systems Utilities
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Shadow Copies creation using operating systems utilities, possible credential access
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Shadow Copies Deletion Using Operating Systems Utilities
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Shadow Copies deletion using operating systems utilities
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Michael Haag, Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, Andreas Hunkele

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Windows Shell/Scripting Processes Spawning Suspicious Programs
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious child processes of a Windows shell and scripting processes such as wscript, rundll32, powershell, mshta...etc.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Tim Shelton

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Process Creation Using Sysnative Folder
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects process creation events that use the Sysnative folder (common for CobaltStrike spawns)
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: System File Execution Location Anomaly
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of a Windows system binary that is usually located in the system folder from an uncommon location.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Patrick Bareiss, Anton Kutepov, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious SYSTEM User Process Creation
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a suspicious process creation as SYSTEM user (suspicious program or command line parameter)
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), David ANDRE (additional keywords)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious SYSVOL Domain Group Policy Access
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects Access to Domain Group Policies stored in SYSVOL
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Markus Neis, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Tasks Folder Evasion
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
The Tasks folder in system32 and syswow64 are globally writable paths.
Adversaries can take advantage of this and load or influence any script hosts or ANY .NET Application
in Tasks to load and execute a custom assembly into cscript, wscript, regsvr32, mshta, eventvwr
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Sreeman

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Userinit Child Process
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a suspicious child process of userinit
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Samir Bousseaden (idea)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Malicious Windows Script Components File Execution by TAEF Detection
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Windows Test Authoring and Execution Framework (TAEF) framework allows you to run automation by executing tests files written on different languages (C, C#, Microsoft COM Scripting interfaces
Adversaries may execute malicious code (such as WSC file with VBScript, dll and so on) directly by running t
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Agro (@agro_sev) oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Malicious PE Execution by Microsoft Visual Studio Debugger
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
There is an option for a MS VS Just-In-Time Debugger "vsjitdebugger.exe" to launch specified executable and attach a debugger.
This option may be used adversaries to execute malicious code by signed verified binary.
The debugger is installed alongside with Microsoft Visual Studio package.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Agro (@agro_sev), Ensar Şamil (@sblmsrsn), oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Velociraptor Child Process
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the suspicious use of the Velociraptor DFIR tool to execute other tools or download additional payloads, as seen in a campaign where it was abused for remote access and to stage further attacks.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Weak or Abused Passwords In CLI
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects weak passwords or often abused passwords (seen used by threat actors) via the CLI.
An example would be a threat actor creating a new user via the net command and providing the password inline
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Usage Of Web Request Commands And Cmdlets
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of various web request commands with commandline tools and Windows PowerShell cmdlets (including aliases) via CommandLine
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: James Pemberton / @4A616D6573, Endgame, JHasenbusch, oscd.community, Austin Songer @austinsonger

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: WhoAmI as Parameter
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a suspicious process command line that uses whoami as first parameter (as e.g. used by EfsPotato)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Execution via WorkFolders.exe

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspect Svchost Activity
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: It is extremely abnormal for svchost.exe to spawn without any CLI arguments and is normally observed when a malicious process spawns the process and injects code into the process memory space.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: David Burkett, @signalblur

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Process Masquerading As SvcHost.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects a suspicious process that is masquerading as the legitimate "svchost.exe" by naming its binary "svchost.exe" and executing from an uncommon location.
Adversaries often disguise their malicious binaries by naming them after legitimate system processes like "svchost.exe" to evade detection.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Terminal Service Process Spawn
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a process spawned by the terminal service server process (this could be an indicator for an exploitation of CVE-2019-0708)
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Uncommon Svchost Command Line Parameter
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects instances of svchost.exe running with an unusual or uncommon command line parameter by excluding known legitimate or common patterns.
This could point at a file masquerading as svchost, a process injection, or hollowing of a legitimate svchost instance.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Liran Ravich

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Uncommon Svchost Parent Process
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects an uncommon svchost parent process
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Permission Check Via Accesschk.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the usage of the "Accesschk" utility, an access and privilege audit tool developed by SysInternal and often being abused by attacker to verify process privileges
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Mangatas Tondang, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Active Directory Database Snapshot Via ADExplorer
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of Sysinternals ADExplorer with the "-snapshot" flag in order to save a local copy of the active directory database. This can be used by attackers to extract data for Bloodhound, usernames for password spraying or use the meta data for social engineering. The snapshot doesn't c
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Active Directory Database Snapshot Via ADExplorer
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of Sysinternals ADExplorer with the "-snapshot" flag in order to save a local copy of the active directory database to a suspicious directory. This can be used by attackers to extract data for Bloodhound, usernames for password spraying or use the meta data for social engineeri
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Execution of Sysinternals Tools
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects command lines that contain the 'accepteula' flag which could be a sign of execution of one of the Sysinternals tools
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Markus Neis

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Memory Dumping Activity Via LiveKD
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects execution of LiveKD based on PE metadata or image name
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Kernel Memory Dump Via LiveKD
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects execution of LiveKD with the "-m" flag to potentially dump the kernel memory
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Procdump Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects usage of the SysInternals Procdump utility
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential SysInternals ProcDump Evasion
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects uses of the SysInternals ProcDump utility in which ProcDump or its output get renamed, or a dump file is moved or copied to a different name
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential LSASS Process Dump Via Procdump
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects potential credential harvesting attempts through LSASS memory dumps using ProcDump.
This rule identifies suspicious command-line patterns that combine memory dump flags (-ma, -mm, -mp) with LSASS-related process markers.
LSASS (Local Security Authority Subsystem Service) contains sensitive a

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Psexec Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects user accept agreement execution in psexec commandline
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: omkar72

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PsExec/PAExec Escalation to LOCAL SYSTEM
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious commandline flags used by PsExec and PAExec to escalate a command line to LOCAL_SYSTEM rights
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential PsExec Remote Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential psexec command that initiate execution on a remote systems via common commandline flags used by the utility
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PsExec Service Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects launch of the PSEXESVC service, which means that this system was the target of a psexec remote execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Thomas Patzke, Romaissa Adjailia, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: PsExec Service Child Process Execution as LOCAL SYSTEM
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious launch of the PSEXESVC service on this system and a sub process run as LOCAL_SYSTEM (-s), which means that someone remotely started a command on this system running it with highest privileges and not only the privileges of the login user account (e.g. the administrator account)
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Use of PsLogList
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects usage of the PsLogList utility to dump event log in order to extract admin accounts and perform account discovery or delete events logs
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Sysinternals PsService Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects usage of Sysinternals PsService which can be abused for service reconnaissance and tampering
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Sysinternals PsSuspend Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects usage of Sysinternals PsSuspend which can be abused to suspend critical processes
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Sysinternals PsSuspend Suspicious Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious execution of Sysinternals PsSuspend, where the utility is used to suspend critical processes such as AV or EDR to bypass defenses
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential File Overwrite Via Sysinternals SDelete
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the use of SDelete to erase a file not the free space
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Privilege Escalation To LOCAL SYSTEM
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects unknown program using commandline flags usually used by tools such as PsExec and PAExec to start programs with SYSTEM Privileges
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Sysmon Configuration Update
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects updates to Sysmon's configuration. Attackers might update or replace the Sysmon configuration with a bare bone one to avoid monitoring without shutting down the service completely
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Uninstall Sysinternals Sysmon
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the removal of Sysmon, which could be a potential attempt at defense evasion
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Binary Impersonating Sysinternals Tools
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects binaries that use the same name as legitimate sysinternals tools to evade detection.
This rule looks for the execution of binaries that are named similarly to Sysinternals tools.
Adversary may rename their malicious tools as legitimate Sysinternals tools to evade detection.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Sysprep on AppData Folder
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious sysprep process start with AppData folder as target (as used by Trojan Syndicasec in Thrip report by Symantec)
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Execution of Systeminfo
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects usage of the "systeminfo" command to retrieve information
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential Signing Bypass Via Windows Developer Features
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects when a user enable developer features such as "Developer Mode" or "Application Sideloading". Which allows the user to install untrusted packages.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Recursive Takeown
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Adversaries can interact with the DACLs using built-in Windows commands takeown which can grant adversaries higher permissions on specific files and folders
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: frack113

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Tap Installer Execution
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Well-known TAP software installation. Possible preparation for data exfiltration using tunneling techniques
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Ian Davis, oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Compressed File Creation Via Tar.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects execution of "tar.exe" in order to create a compressed file.
Adversaries may abuse various utilities to compress or encrypt data before exfiltration.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), AdmU3

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Compressed File Extraction Via Tar.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects execution of "tar.exe" in order to extract compressed file.
Adversaries may abuse various utilities in order to decompress data to avoid detection.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: AdmU3

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Taskkill Symantec Endpoint Protection
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects one of the possible scenarios for disabling Symantec Endpoint Protection.
Symantec Endpoint Protection antivirus software services incorrectly implement the protected service mechanism.
As a result, the NT AUTHORITY/SYSTEM user can execute the taskkill /im command several times ccSvcHst.exe
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Ilya Krestinichev, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Loaded Module Enumeration Via Tasklist.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects the enumeration of a specific DLL or EXE being used by a binary via "tasklist.exe".
This is often used by attackers in order to find the specific process identifier (PID) that is using the DLL in question.
In order to dump the process memory or perform other nefarious actions.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Taskmgr as LOCAL_SYSTEM
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the creation of taskmgr.exe process in context of LOCAL_SYSTEM
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: New Process Created Via Taskmgr.EXE

process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potentially Suspicious Command Targeting Teams Sensitive Files
process_creation\u001fwindows.description:
Detects a commandline containing references to the Microsoft Teams database or cookies files from a process other than Teams.
The database might contain authentication tokens and other sensitive information about the logged in accounts.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: @SerkinValery

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: New Virtual Smart Card Created Via TpmVscMgr.EXE
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects execution of "Tpmvscmgr.exe" to create a new virtual smart card.
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious TSCON Start as SYSTEM
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a tscon.exe start as LOCAL SYSTEM
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious RDP Redirect Using TSCON
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects a suspicious RDP session redirect using tscon.exe
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Potential RDP Session Hijacking Activity
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential RDP Session Hijacking activity on Windows systems
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: @juju4

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: UAC Bypass Using ChangePK and SLUI
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects an UAC bypass that uses changepk.exe and slui.exe (UACMe 61)
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: UAC Bypass Using Disk Cleanup
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using scheduled tasks and variable expansion of cleanmgr.exe (UACMe 34)
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: Bypass UAC via CMSTP
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detect commandline usage of Microsoft Connection Manager Profile Installer (cmstp.exe) to install specially formatted local .INF files
process_creation\u001fwindows.author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community

process_creation\u001fwindows.title: CMSTP UAC Bypass via COM Object Access
process_creation\u001fwindows.description: Detects UAC Bypass Attempt Using Microsoft Connection Manager Profile Installer Autoelevate-capable COM Objects (e.g. UACMe ID of 41, 43, 58 or 65)
