Detects when the "index" value of a scheduled task is modified from the registry
Which effectively hides it from any tooling such as "schtasks /query" (Read the referenced link for more information about the effects of this technique)
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Driver Added To Disallowed Images In HVCI - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the "HVCIDisallowedImages" registry value to potentially add a driver to the list, in order to prevent it from loading.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Omar Khaled (@beacon_exe)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: IE ZoneMap Setting Downgraded To MyComputer Zone For HTTP Protocols
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to Internet Explorer's (IE / Windows Internet properties) ZoneMap configuration of the "HTTP" and "HTTPS" protocols to point to the "My Computer" zone. This allows downloaded files from the Internet to be granted the same level of trust as files stored locally.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Michael Haag (idea)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Uncommon Extension In Keyboard Layout IME File Registry Value
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects usage of Windows Input Method Editor (IME) keyboard layout feature, which allows an attacker to load a DLL into the process after sending the WM_INPUTLANGCHANGEREQUEST message.
Before doing this, the client needs to register the DLL in a special registry key that is assumed to implement this
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Path In Keyboard Layout IME File Registry Value
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects usage of Windows Input Method Editor (IME) keyboard layout feature, which allows an attacker to load a DLL into the process after sending the WM_INPUTLANGCHANGEREQUEST message.
Before doing this, the client needs to register the DLL in a special registry key that is assumed to implement this
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: New Root or CA or AuthRoot Certificate to Store
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the addition of new root, CA or AuthRoot certificates to the Windows registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Internet Explorer DisableFirstRunCustomize Enabled
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the Internet Explorer "DisableFirstRunCustomize" value, which prevents Internet Explorer from running the first run wizard the first time a user starts the browser after installing Internet Explorer or Windows.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Ransomware Activity Using LegalNotice Message
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detect changes to the "LegalNoticeCaption" or "LegalNoticeText" registry values where the message set contains keywords often used in ransomware ransom messages
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Lolbas OneDriveStandaloneUpdater.exe Proxy Download
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects setting a custom URL for OneDriveStandaloneUpdater.exe to download a file from the Internet without executing any
anomalous executables with suspicious arguments. The downloaded file will be in C:\Users\redacted\AppData\Local\Microsoft\OneDrive\StandaloneUpdaterreSignInSettingsConfig.json
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Lsass Full Dump Request Via DumpType Registry Settings
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the setting of the "DumpType" registry value to "2" which stands for a "Full Dump". Technique such as LSASS Shtinkering requires this value to be "2" in order to dump LSASS.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: @pbssubhash

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: RestrictedAdminMode Registry Value Tampering
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects changes to the "DisableRestrictedAdmin" registry value in order to disable or enable RestrictedAdmin mode.
RestrictedAdmin mode prevents the transmission of reusable credentials to the remote system to which you connect using Remote Desktop.
This prevents your credentials from being harveste
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Netsh Helper DLL - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the Netsh registry key to add a new DLL value. This change might be an indication of a potential persistence attempt by adding a malicious Netsh helper
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Anish Bogati

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: New Netsh Helper DLL Registered From A Suspicious Location
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the Netsh registry key to add a new DLL value that is located on a suspicious location. This change might be an indication of a potential persistence attempt by adding a malicious Netsh helper
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: NET NGenAssemblyUsageLog Registry Key Tamper
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects changes to the NGenAssemblyUsageLog registry key.
.NET Usage Log output location can be controlled by setting the NGenAssemblyUsageLog CLR configuration knob in the Registry or by configuring an environment variable (as described in the next section).
By simplify specifying an arbitrary valu
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: New Application in AppCompat
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: A General detection for a new application in AppCompat. This indicates an application executing for the first time on an endpoint.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Credential Dumping Attempt Using New NetworkProvider - REG
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects when an attacker tries to add a new network provider in order to dump clear text credentials, similar to how the NPPSpy tool does it
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: New ODBC Driver Registered
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the registration of a new ODBC driver.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potentially Suspicious ODBC Driver Registered
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the registration of a new ODBC driver where the driver is located in a potentially suspicious location
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Trust Access Disable For VBApplications
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects registry changes to Microsoft Office "AccessVBOM" to a value of "1" which disables trust access for VBA on the victim machine and lets attackers execute malicious macros without any Microsoft Office warnings.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Trent Liffick (@tliffick), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Microsoft Office Protected View Disabled
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to Microsoft Office protected view registry keys with which the attacker disables this feature.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Python Function Execution Security Warning Disabled In Excel - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects changes to the registry value "PythonFunctionWarnings" that would prevent any warnings or alerts from showing when Python functions are about to be executed.
Threat actors could run malicious code through the new Microsoft Excel feature that allows Python to run within the spreadsheet.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), @Kostastsale

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Enable Microsoft Dynamic Data Exchange
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Enable Dynamic Data Exchange protocol (DDE) in all supported editions of Microsoft Word or Excel.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Outlook LoadMacroProviderOnBoot Setting
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the modification of Outlook setting "LoadMacroProviderOnBoot" which if enabled allows the automatic loading of any configured VBA project/module
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Outlook Macro Execution Without Warning Setting Enabled
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the modification of Outlook security setting to allow unprompted execution of macros.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: @ScoubiMtl

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Outlook EnableUnsafeClientMailRules Setting Enabled - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects an attacker trying to enable the outlook security setting "EnableUnsafeClientMailRules" which allows outlook to run applications or execute macros
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Outlook Security Settings Updated - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the registry values related to outlook security settings
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Uncommon Microsoft Office Trusted Location Added
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to registry keys related to "Trusted Location" of Microsoft Office where the path is set to something uncommon. Attackers might add additional trusted locations to avoid macro security restrictions.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Macro Enabled In A Potentially Suspicious Document
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects registry changes to Office trust records where the path is located in a potentially suspicious location
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Office Macros Warning Disabled
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects registry changes to Microsoft Office "VBAWarning" to a value of "1" which enables the execution of all macros, whether signed or unsigned.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Trent Liffick (@tliffick), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: MaxMpxCt Registry Value Changed
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects changes to the "MaxMpxCt" registry value.
MaxMpxCt specifies the maximum outstanding network requests for the server per client, which is used when negotiating a Server Message Block (SMB) connection with a client. Note if the value is set beyond 125 older Windows 9x clients will fail to neg
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via New AMSI Providers - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects when an attacker adds a new AMSI provider via the Windows Registry to bypass AMSI (Antimalware Scan Interface) protections.
Attackers may add custom AMSI providers to persist on the system and evade detection by security software that relies on AMSI for scanning scripts and other content.
Th
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Using DebugPath
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential persistence using Appx DebugPath
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via AppCompat RegisterAppRestart Layer
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects the setting of the REGISTERAPPRESTART compatibility layer on an application.
This compatibility layer allows an application to register for restart using the "RegisterApplicationRestart" API.
This can be potentially abused as a persistence mechanism.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via App Paths Default Property
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects changes to the "Default" property for keys located in the \Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\ registry. Which might be used as a method of persistence
The entries found under App Paths are used primarily for the following purposes.
First, to map an application's executable
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via AutodialDLL
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects change the the "AutodialDLL" key which could be used as a persistence method to load custom DLL via the "ws2_32" library
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via CHM Helper DLL
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects when an attacker modifies the registry key "HtmlHelp Author" to achieve persistence
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential PSFactoryBuffer COM Hijacking
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the PSFactory COM InProcServer32 registry. This technique was used by RomCom to create persistence storing a malicious DLL.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: BlackBerry Threat Research and Intelligence Team - @Joseliyo_Jstnk

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: COM Object Hijacking Via Modification Of Default System CLSID Default Value
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential COM object hijacking via modification of default system CLSID.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential COM Object Hijacking Via TreatAs Subkey - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects COM object hijacking via TreatAs subkey
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Kutepov Anton, oscd.community

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Custom Protocol Handler
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential persistence activity via the registering of a new custom protocole handlers. While legitimate applications register protocole handlers often times during installation. And attacker can abuse this by setting a custom handler to be used as a persistence mechanism.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Event Viewer Events.asp
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential registry persistence technique using the Event Viewer "Events.asp" technique
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via GlobalFlags
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects registry persistence technique using the GlobalFlags and SilentProcessExit keys
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Karneades, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Florian Roth

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Modification of IE Registry Settings
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects modification of the registry settings used for Internet Explorer and other Windows components that use these settings. An attacker can abuse this registry key to add a domain to the trusted sites Zone or insert JavaScript for persistence
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Register New IFiltre For Persistence
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects when an attacker registers a new IFilter for an extension. Microsoft Windows Search uses filters to extract the content of items for inclusion in a full-text index.
You can extend Windows Search to index new or proprietary file types by writing filters to extract the content, and property ha
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Logon Scripts - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects creation of "UserInitMprLogonScript" registry value which can be used as a persistence method by malicious actors
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Tom Ueltschi (@c_APT_ure)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via LSA Extensions
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects when an attacker modifies the "REG_MULTI_SZ" value named "Extensions" to include a custom DLL to achieve persistence via lsass.
The "Extensions" list contains filenames of DLLs being automatically loaded by lsass.exe. Each DLL has its InitializeLsaExtension() method called after loading.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Mpnotify
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects when an attacker register a new SIP provider for persistence and defense evasion
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via MyComputer Registry Keys
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects modification to the "Default" value of the "MyComputer" key and subkeys to point to a custom binary that will be launched whenever the associated action is executed (see reference section for example)
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via DLLPathOverride
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects when an attacker adds a new "DLLPathOverride" value to the "Natural Language" key in order to achieve persistence which will get invoked by "SearchIndexer.exe" process
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Visual Studio Tools for Office
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects persistence via Visual Studio Tools for Office (VSTO) add-ins in Office applications.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Bhabesh Raj

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Outlook Home Page
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects potential persistence activity via outlook home page.
An attacker can set a home page to achieve code execution and persistence by editing the WebView registry keys.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems), David Bertho (@dbertho) & Eirik Sveen (@0xSV1), Storebrand

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Outlook Today Page
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects potential persistence activity via outlook today page.
An attacker can set a custom page to execute arbitrary code and link to it via the registry values "URL" and "UserDefinedUrl".
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems), David Bertho (@dbertho) & Eirik Sveen (@0xSV1), Storebrand

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential WerFault ReflectDebugger Registry Value Abuse
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential WerFault "ReflectDebugger" registry value abuse for persistence.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: X__Junior

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Scrobj.dll COM Hijacking
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detect use of scrobj.dll as this DLL looks for the ScriptletURL key to get the location of the script to execute
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Shim Database Modification
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Adversaries may establish persistence and/or elevate privileges by executing malicious content triggered by application shims.
The Microsoft Windows Application Compatibility Infrastructure/Framework (Application Shim) was created to allow for backward compatibility of software as the operating syst
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Shim Database Patching Activity
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects installation of new shim databases that try to patch sections of known processes for potential process injection or persistence.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Shim Database In Uncommon Location
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the installation of a new shim database where the file is located in a non-default location
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via TypedPaths
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects modification addition to the 'TypedPaths' key in the user or admin registry from a non standard application. Which might indicate persistence attempt
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Persistence Via Excel Add-in - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detect potential persistence via the creation of an excel add-in (XLL) file to make it run automatically when Excel is started.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Attachment Manager Settings Associations Tamper
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects tampering with attachment manager settings policies associations to lower the default file type risks (See reference for more information)
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Attachment Manager Settings Attachments Tamper
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects tampering with attachment manager settings policies attachments (See reference for more information)
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential ClickFix Execution Pattern - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects potential ClickFix malware execution patterns by monitoring registry modifications in RunMRU keys containing HTTP/HTTPS links.
ClickFix is known to be distributed through phishing campaigns and uses techniques like clipboard hijacking and fake CAPTCHA pages.
Through the fakecaptcha pages, th
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Registry Modification for OCI DLL Redirection
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects registry modifications related to 'OracleOciLib' and 'OracleOciLibPath' under 'MSDTC' settings.
Threat actors may modify these registry keys to redirect the loading of 'oci.dll' to a malicious DLL, facilitating phantom DLL hijacking via the MSDTC service.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: PowerShell as a Service in Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects that a powershell code is written to the registry as a service.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: oscd.community, Natalia Shornikova

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: PowerShell Script Execution Policy Enabled
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the enabling of the PowerShell script execution policy. Once enabled, this policy allows scripts to be executed.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Thurein Oo

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential PowerShell Execution Policy Tampering
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the PowerShell execution policy in order to bypass signing requirements for script execution
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious PowerShell In Registry Run Keys
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential PowerShell commands or code within registry run keys
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: PowerShell Logging Disabled Via Registry Key Tampering
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the registry for the currently logged-in user. In order to disable PowerShell module logging, script block logging or transcription and script execution logging
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Provisioning Registry Key Abuse For Binary Proxy Execution - REG
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential abuse of the provisioning registry key for indirect command execution through "Provlaunch.exe".
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Sysinternal Tool Execution - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of a Sysinternals Tool via the creation of the "accepteula" registry key
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Markus Neis

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Execution Of Renamed Sysinternals Tools - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the creation of the "accepteula" key related to the Sysinternals tools being created from executables with the wrong name (e.g. a renamed Sysinternals tool)
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: PUA - Sysinternals Tools Execution - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the execution of some potentially unwanted tools such as PsExec, Procdump, etc. (part of the Sysinternals suite) via the creation of the "accepteula" registry key.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Usage of Renamed Sysinternals Tools - RegistrySet
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects non-sysinternals tools setting the "accepteula" key which normally is set on sysinternals tool execution
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: ETW Logging Disabled For rpcrt4.dll
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the "ExtErrorInformation" key in order to disable ETW logging for rpcrt4.dll
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potentially Suspicious Command Executed Via Run Dialog Box - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects execution of commands via the run dialog box on Windows by checking values of the "RunMRU" registry key.
This technique was seen being abused by threat actors to deceive users into pasting and executing malicious commands, often disguised as CAPTCHA verification steps.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Ahmed Farouk, Nasreddine Bencherchali

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: ScreenSaver Registry Key Set
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects registry key established after masqueraded .scr file execution using Rundll32 through desk.cpl
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Jose Luis Sanchez Martinez (@Joseliyo_Jstnk)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential SentinelOne Shell Context Menu Scan Command Tampering
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects potentially suspicious changes to the SentinelOne context menu scan command by a process other than SentinelOne.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: ServiceDll Hijack
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects changes to the "ServiceDLL" value related to a service in the registry.
This is often used as a method of persistence.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: ETW Logging Disabled For SCM
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the "TracingDisabled" key in order to disable ETW logging for services.exe (SCM)
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Registry Explorer Policy Modification
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects registry modifications that disable internal tools or functions in explorer (malware like Agent Tesla uses this technique)
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Persistence Via New SIP Provider
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects when an attacker register a new SIP provider for persistence and defense evasion
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Tamper With Sophos AV Registry Keys
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects tamper attempts to sophos av functionality via registry key modification
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Hiding User Account Via SpecialAccounts Registry Key
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects modifications to the registry key "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\SpecialAccounts\Userlist" where the value is set to "0" in order to hide user account from being listed on the logon screen.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Activate Suppression of Windows Security Center Notifications
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detect set Notification_Suppress to 1 to disable the Windows security center notification
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Environment Variable Has Been Registered
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the creation of user-specific or system-wide environment variables via the registry. Which contains suspicious commands and strings
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Keyboard Layout Load
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the keyboard preload installation with a suspicious keyboard layout, e.g. Chinese, Iranian or Vietnamese layout load in user session on systems maintained by US staff only
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential PendingFileRenameOperations Tampering
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detect changes to the "PendingFileRenameOperations" registry key from uncommon or suspicious images locations to stage currently used files for rename or deletion after reboot.

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Printer Driver Empty Manufacturer
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects a suspicious printer driver installation with an empty Manufacturer value
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Registry Persistence via Explorer Run Key
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects a possible persistence mechanism using RUN key for Windows Explorer and pointing to a suspicious folder

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Space Characters in RunMRU Registry Path - ClickFix
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the occurrence of numerous space characters in RunMRU registry paths, which may indicate execution via phishing lures using clickfix techniques to hide malicious commands in the Windows Run dialog box from naked eyes.

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: New RUN Key Pointing to Suspicious Folder

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Service Installed
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects installation of NalDrv or PROCEXP152 services via registry-keys to non-system32 folders.
Both services are used in the tool Ghost-In-The-Logs (https://github.com/bats3c/Ghost-In-The-Logs), which uses KDU (https://github.com/hfiref0x/KDU)
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: xknow (@xknow_infosec), xorxes (@xor_xes)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Shell Open Command Registry Modification
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects modifications to shell open registry keys that point to suspicious locations typically used by malware for persistence.

registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Space Characters in TypedPaths Registry Path - FileFix
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the occurrence of numerous space characters in TypedPaths registry paths, which may indicate execution via phishing lures using file-fix techniques to hide malicious commands.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Modify User Shell Folders Startup Value
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detect modification of the User Shell Folders registry values for Startup or Common Startup which could indicate persistence attempts.
Attackers may modify User Shell Folders registry keys to point to malicious executables or scripts that will be executed during startup.
This technique is often used
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: WFP Filter Added via Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects registry modifications that add Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) filters, which may be used to block security tools and EDR agents from reporting events.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Enable LM Hash Storage
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects changes to the "NoLMHash" registry value in order to allow Windows to store LM Hashes.
By setting this registry value to "0" (DWORD), Windows will be allowed to store a LAN manager hash of your password in Active Directory and local SAM databases.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Scheduled TaskCache Change by Uncommon Program
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Monitor the creation of a new key under 'TaskCache' when a new scheduled task is registered by a process that is not svchost.exe, which is suspicious
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Syed Hasan (@syedhasan009)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Registry Persistence Attempt Via Windows Telemetry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects potential persistence behavior using the windows telemetry registry key.
Windows telemetry makes use of the binary CompatTelRunner.exe to run a variety of commands and perform the actual telemetry collections.

registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Lednyov Alexey, oscd.community, Sreeman

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: RDP Sensitive Settings Changed to Zero
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects tampering of RDP Terminal Service/Server sensitive settings.
Such as allowing unauthorized users access to a system via the 'fAllowUnsolicited' or enabling RDP via 'fDenyTSConnections', etc.

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: New TimeProviders Registered With Uncommon DLL Name
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects processes setting a new DLL in DllName in under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\W32Time\TimeProvider.
Adversaries may abuse time providers to execute DLLs when the system boots.
The Windows Time service (W32Time) enables time synchronization across and within domains.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Old TLS1.0/TLS1.1 Protocol Version Enabled
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects applications or users re-enabling old TLS versions by setting the "Enabled" value to "1" for the "Protocols" registry key.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: COM Hijacking via TreatAs
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detect modification of TreatAs key to enable "rundll32.exe -sta" command
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Potential Signing Bypass Via Windows Developer Features - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects when the enablement of developer features such as "Developer Mode" or "Application Sideloading". Which allows the user to install untrusted packages.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: UAC Bypass via Event Viewer
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects UAC bypass method using Windows event viewer
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: UAC Bypass via Sdclt
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using registry key manipulation of sdclt.exe (e.g. UACMe 53)
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Omer Yampel, Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: UAC Bypass Abusing Winsat Path Parsing - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using a path parsing issue in winsat.exe (UACMe 52)
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: UAC Bypass Using Windows Media Player - Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using Windows Media Player osksupport.dll (UACMe 32)
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: UAC Disabled
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects when an attacker tries to disable User Account Control (UAC) by setting the registry value "EnableLUA" to 0.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: UAC Notification Disabled
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects when an attacker tries to disable User Account Control (UAC) notification by tampering with the "UACDisableNotify" value.
UAC is a critical security feature in Windows that prevents unauthorized changes to the operating system. It prompts the user for permission or an administrator password
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: UAC Secure Desktop Prompt Disabled
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects when an attacker tries to change User Account Control (UAC) elevation request destination via the "PromptOnSecureDesktop" value.
The "PromptOnSecureDesktop" setting specifically determines whether UAC prompts are displayed on the secure desktop. The secure desktop is a separate desktop envir
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: VBScript Payload Stored in Registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects VBScript content stored into registry keys as seen being used by UNC2452 group
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Windows Vulnerable Driver Blocklist Disabled
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:

and its modification may indicate an attempt to bypass security controls. It is often targeted by threat actors to facilitate the installation of m
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Execution DLL of Choice Using WAB.EXE
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: This rule detects that the path to the DLL written in the registry is different from the default one. Launched WAB.exe tries to load the DLL from Registry.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: oscd.community, Natalia Shornikova

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Wdigest Enable UseLogonCredential
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects potential malicious modification of the property value of UseLogonCredential from HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest to enable clear-text credentials
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Disable Windows Defender Functionalities Via Registry Keys
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects when attackers or tools disable Windows Defender functionalities via the Windows registry
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: AlertIQ, Ján Trenčanský, frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Winget Admin Settings Modification
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the AppInstaller (winget) admin settings. Such as enabling local manifest installations or disabling installer hash checks
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Enable Local Manifest Installation With Winget
registry_set\u001fwindows.description: Detects changes to the AppInstaller (winget) policy. Specifically the activation of the local manifest installation, which allows a user to install new packages via custom manifests.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Winlogon AllowMultipleTSSessions Enable
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Detects when the 'AllowMultipleTSSessions' value is enabled.
Which allows for multiple Remote Desktop connection sessions to be opened at once.
This is often used by attacker as a way to connect to an RDP session without disconnecting the other users
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

registry_set\u001fwindows.title: Winlogon Notify Key Logon Persistence
registry_set\u001fwindows.description:
Adversaries may abuse features of Winlogon to execute DLLs and/or executables when a user logs in.
Winlogon.exe is a Windows component responsible for actions at logon/logoff as well as the secure attention sequence (SAS) triggered by Ctrl-Alt-Delete.
registry_set\u001fwindows.author: frack113

sysmon_error\u001fwindows.title: Sysmon Configuration Error
sysmon_error\u001fwindows.description: Detects when an adversary is trying to hide it's action from Sysmon logging based on error messages
sysmon_error\u001fwindows.author: frack113

sysmon_status\u001fwindows.title: Sysmon Configuration Modification
sysmon_status\u001fwindows.description: Detects when an attacker tries to hide from Sysmon by disabling or stopping it
sysmon_status\u001fwindows.author: frack113

wmi_event\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Encoded Scripts in a WMI Consumer
wmi_event\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious encoded payloads in WMI Event Consumers
wmi_event\u001fwindows.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

wmi_event\u001fwindows.title: Suspicious Scripting in a WMI Consumer
wmi_event\u001fwindows.description: Detects suspicious commands that are related to scripting/powershell in WMI Event Consumers
